turns.content: I just lost my job at the bank downtown.
That is rough. What is the plan from here?
I want to open a dance studio. I have danced since childhood and I prefer contemporary dance.
A studio has been the goal for a while then.
Yes. My friend Lena runs a small gallery and she says she can help me look at spaces.
Lena found a place with natural light, right in the old market quarter.
How big is it?
Two rooms. I want Marley flooring, that is what I trained on.
And the rent?
Manageable. I visited Paris last week and saw three studios there, which helped me decide.
I am searching for a place to open the studio, and I am also working on my first show.
What is the show?
A short contemporary piece about leaving a job. Lena is helping me with the poster.
Any date yet?
I want it before the February festival, so I am rehearsing three evenings a week.
The lease is signed. The studio opens in the old market quarter.
Congratulations. Who is helping with the business side?
Lena handles the paperwork. Her help means a lot to me.
What is the first class?
A beginner contemporary class on Tuesday evenings. I am preparing a March competition too.
The festival performance went well. We placed first in the local competition in 2022, and this felt the same.
Are you still teaching the Tuesday class?
Yes, twelve students signed up. I also started an online clothing store to fund the studio.
Is the store doing anything?
It covers the rent. Lena models some of the pieces.
I lost the bank job in January and the studio is now my full-time work.
Any news on the March competition?
I entered the duet category. I am coaching with Lena twice a week.
How many classes are running now?
Four. Contemporary, beginner ballet, a kids class, and an open floor session.
The March competition is done. We did not place, but the piece was well received.
What is next?
A summer workshop. I want to run it at the studio over two weekends.
Will Lena be involved?
She is doing the photography for the workshop flyer.
Small update: the studio now has a second room finished, and the flooring is finally the Marley I wanted.
That changes the class schedule?
Yes. The workshop is set for the first two weekends of July, and the Tuesday class moves to the larger room.
And the clothing store?
Still running. It pays for the second room.
